title.narrative: Development of the Sustainable Forest & Landscape Program of Cote d’Ivoire

description.narrative: This project aims to develop an analysis report on the current landscape and forest situation in Cote d’Ivoire. The report will provide a baseline assessment prior to launching GGGI intervention as part of the sustainable forest and landscape line of services. This project will also provide a status of past, current, and future initiatives on landscape, forest, and agroforestry.
